trials.claim: Scrape unlimited data with no limits from partner
trials.claimQuote: Scrape unlimited data - no limits from partner
trials.reasoning: The vendor states there are no daily or monthly scraping limits from its end and offers unlimited data search. YellowPages-side IP limits do not contradict the claim that the partner/vendor imposes no limits.

exhibits.quote: However, the YellowPages may have their own limits, which can be bypassed using proxies or VPN.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited scraping is still subject to YellowPages-side limits requiring proxies or VPN.

exhibits.quote: When I search a local page, I receive an error stating that my IP address may be blocked and recommending that I use a VPN.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being blocked by IP limits despite the unlimited claim.

exhibits.quote: There are no daily or monthly scraping limits available from our end.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms vendor imposes no daily or monthly scraping limits.

exhibits.quote: We offer unlimited data search opportunities with our software.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms vendor offers unlimited data search with its software.

trials.claim: Ultimate version has no daily or monthly usage limits imposed by Reoon
trials.claimQuote: For the Ultimate version, there are no daily or monthly usage limits imposed by Reoon.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states the Ultimate version has no scraping limit from its end and allows extracting as much data as possible during the subscription. The subscription-period wording does not impose a daily or monthly limit.

exhibits.quote: The users are allowed to scrape unlimited data from any YellowPages for as long as they are subscribed.
exhibits.argument: No-limits promise is time-boxed to active subscription period.

exhibits.quote: Reoon Technology reserves the right to cancel the license and stop providing service to any of its customers (or anyone)
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to cancel license and stop service, allowing revocation of access.

exhibits.quote: There is not scraping limit from our end for the ultimate version.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms ultimate version has no scraping limit from vendor.

exhibits.quote: You are allowed to extract/scrape as much data as you can within your subscription period.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms unlimited extraction allowed during subscription period.

trials.claim: Kick start leads list with local business leads
trials.claimQuote: Kick start your leads list with the local businesses leads
trials.reasoning: The vendor promises thousands to millions of local business leads, and a buyer confirms pulling large lists of businesses throughout the US. Reports of missing coverage in some countries limit geography but do not contradict the general lead-list capability.

exhibits.quote: im in nz, so this thing is absolutely pointless.
exhibits.argument: Buyer in NZ reports tool is pointless for local leads due to coverage.

exhibits.quote: I couldn't find Yellow Pages for countries Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand where I do most of my businesses.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports missing country coverage for Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand.

exhibits.quote: Grow your leads list with thousands to millions of local business leads.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms tool grows leads list with local business leads.

exhibits.quote: It has been incredibly helpful in pulling large lists of businesses throughout the US in various categories.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms tool pulls large lists of businesses for lead building.

trials.claim: Get email, phone and social media leads for business
trials.claimQuote: Get email, phone, and social media leads for your business
trials.reasoning: The vendor states the software provides email, phone, and social media leads and crawls company websites for those details. Dependence on source-site availability and a low email hit rate limit yield but do not show the feature is absent.

exhibits.quote: Please note that the availability of the mentioned points depends on the availability of them in the original sites.
exhibits.argument: Email, phone and social data are not guaranteed and depend on source sites.

exhibits.quote: in my case it finds email addresses of 1 in 8 scraped profiles.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports only 1 in 8 profiles yielded email addresses.

exhibits.quote: Get email, phone, and social media leads of your potential customers.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms tool provides email, phone and social media leads.

exhibits.quote: The software also allows you to crawl the companies’ websites for the latest information which includes email addresses, phone numbers and social media profiles.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms software extracts email addresses, phone numbers and social profiles.

trials.claim: Crawl business websites for most up to date data
trials.claimQuote: Crawl business websites for the most up to date data
trials.reasoning: The vendor states crawling business websites obtained from Yellow Pages provides the most up-to-date data, and a buyer confirms it yields more recent and accurate data. Discrepancies from businesses' own outdated information do not contradict website crawling.

exhibits.quote: There are some discrepancies in the data but that is most likely due to the businesses not keeping their information updated.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports data discrepancies because businesses do not keep information updated.

exhibits.quote: which misses quite a few emails unfortunately, even if they are available, but It's still working well most of the time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports website crawler misses emails even when available.

exhibits.quote: Crawl business websites obtained from yellow pages for the most up-to-date data.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms website crawling provides most up-to-date data.

exhibits.quote: It can crawl the business websites (software collects the website links from the yellow pages) of the listed companies to obtain more recent and accurate data.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms crawling business websites yields more recent and accurate data.
